nightCard.featuredLine: Tonight is Priya's first real gig.
lines: The tide's over the Harbour line. Tonight Harbour is only reachable through Market.
Not everyone will make it home on time.
nightCard.footnote: The lighthouse keeper waves at any train through Harbour by ten past.

platform.headline: She's on at quarter past.
platform.coach: One question tonight. Then promise one of them.

passengers.name: Priya
passengers.platform: On at quarter past. I've been sick twice and there's a plectrum in every pocket.
passengers.ask: My mum's coming. She's only ever heard me play through a bedroom door.

onTime.line: She walked on at quarter past exactly. The first chord was too loud, and perfect.
onTime.logLine: The first chord was too loud, and perfect.

late.line: They'd moved her to last. She played to the bar staff and her mum.
late.carry: Priya will still play the platform for the last train on Friday.

notReached.line: Her mum filmed the empty stage. Priya watched it on the train, twice.
notReached.carry: Priya will still play the platform for the last train on Friday.

passengers.name: Agnes
passengers.platform: He sent a photo of the scarf already. Look. He's wearing it indoors.
passengers.ask: I've nobody to knit for now. I might start on the driver.

onTime.line: She went home and cast on something in your colours.

late.line: She dozed off on the train. Nobody minded.

notReached.line: She got a taxi and told the driver all about the ferry.

passengers.name: Wen
passengers.platform: The nurse says he's tired. Tired days are long days.
passengers.ask: Tomorrow he's eighty. I've ordered the cake. I'm just praying he's awake for it.

onTime.line: He was awake, just. She told him about Friday and he smiled at the right part.

late.line: He'd gone to sleep with the light on. She switched it off.

notReached.line: She phoned the night desk. They said he'd asked for her once.

passengers.name: Tomás
passengers.platform: Hillside. Big order tomorrow for the closing party.
passengers.ask: The big order's not till one, as it happens. Five to is fine. Eleven years of loaves, and tomorrow it's the party ones.

onTime.line: In early. He shaped the party loaves like little trains.

late.line: Late again. The manager sighed and handed him an apron.

notReached.line: He called in. Second time ever.

variants.platform: The post boat takes parcels until twenty-five past. The scarf's going by post.
variants.planQuote: The post boat goes at twenty-five past.

onTime.line: The parcel went over the water, addressed in her best hand.

late.line: The post boat's lights were already small. Monday, then.

notReached.line: She carried the parcel home again, under her arm.

variants.platform: Brought you a loaf. Rye. Don't tell the manager.
Last loaves of my last week. Might as well make them good ones.
variants.planQuote: Last loaves of my last week.

variants.platform: You promised, love. Never mind. The post boat takes parcels until twenty-five past.
variants.planQuote: The post boat goes at twenty-five past.

variants.platform: The nurse says come earlier now. He's slipping in the evenings.

coach.text: Tonight is Priya's first real gig. You promised {promised}. Click a glowing station to start.
Three of four is the most anyone can do tonight, and every way to get three leaves Priya waiting. Saving her costs someone else.
You promised {promised}. On this route, they won't make it.
Two of four. {waiting} would wait. Is it worth it? Only you can say.

logbook.tomorrow: Friday is the last train, and Wen's dad turns eighty.
